title: Local constant finite-module model for bounded cohomology on a site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with final object $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], and let $B$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $K\in D(\mathcal C,\underline B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and integers $a\leq b$ satisfy $H^q(K)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Suppose every $H^q(K)$ is locally isomorphic to the constant sheaf of a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There exists a covering $\{U_j\to X\}$ such that on each localized site $\mathcal C/U_j$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], $K|_{U_j}$ is isomorphic in the derived category to the termwise constant sheaf complex $\underline{M_j^\bullet}$, where $M_j^\bullet$ is a cochain complex of finitely generated $B$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $M_j^q=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. The differentials of $\underline{M_j^\bullet}$ are induced by the $B$-linear differentials of $M_j^\bullet$. No existence of points of the site is assumed.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, the strengthened constant-model assertion explicitly proved in its induction

proof.text: When a=b, the concentration theorem [lem-sf-derived-concentrated-single] identifies K with its homology in that degree. Trivialize this finite constant cohomology on the covering given in the hypothesis, restrict the derived isomorphism using exact slice restriction, and use the single complex of the finite coefficient module. The zero terms are finite and have exactly the required bounds.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: When a<b, apply the bounded constant graded-model theorem [lem-weil-pbc-site-bounded-constant-graded-model]. It gives covering members U_i, bounded sheaf complexes P_i, finite coefficient modules in each degree, isomorphisms of the terms with their constants, and derived models of restricted K.

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: Apply finite simultaneous differential descent [lem-weil-pbc-site-finite-constant-complex-descent] to P_i. It gives a covering sieve S_i and, on every further slice V -> U_i in S_i, an actual bounded finite module complex N and a chain isomorphism between the restricted P_i and constant(N).

source.place: Tag 094G, lemma-locally-constant, proof of the strengthened bounded constant-model assertion

proof.text: Exact derived restriction commutes with composition and with Q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; the slice restriction functors are additive and preserve finite limits and colimits by their sheaf adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Compose the comparison for successive derived restrictions, the image of the given K-to-Q(P_i) isomorphism, the comparison of restriction with Q, and Q of the chain isomorphism. This yields the required derived model on each further slice. Each covering sieve contains a precoverage family, since J is stable under composition. Compose those families with the initial covering, using precoverage composition stability. The bounds and finiteness are those already furnished by descent.
